services.name: School Programs
services.desc: In-person and online programs and teacher resources to educate and inspire. To receive email updates about the school programs, including the latest reservation information, please signup here. Soon after opening in 1935, Griffith Observatory initiated one of the first school visit programs in the region. Generations of Los Angeles-area students have made the pilgrimage up Mount Hollywood on school buses for a one-of-a-kind experience in science education. Griffith Observatory offers teachers a chance to bring the universe into their fifth-grade classrooms through our in-person school program or our online school program.
